title: Mofo Gasy
description: Mofo Gasy is a Madagascar classic prepared with rice flour, coconut milk, instant yeast, desiccated coconut. A measured home-style version, with ingredients assigned to the cooking steps where they are used.

steps.instruction: Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Cover the batter loosely and leave in a suitable warm, clean place for about 80 minutes to become bubbly and lightly tangy; do not refrigerate during active fermentation.
Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 23 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
